id: 20_Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For S

source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/20_Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For S.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/20_Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For S（国内版）/src.py

points.K6: 职业健康安全管理体系
points.K20: 制冷剂不能破坏臭氧层
points.K22: 化学品安全技术说明书
points.S1: 实验室微波设备怎么用
points.S2: 实验室不饮食，不用实验容器装水
points.S3: 易燃品存放用防爆冰箱
points.S4: 通风柜随手关窗，节能减废

shots.scene: 欣欣站在课题组休息区的白板前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard in a research group break area and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 午间答题时间到！今天二十道题。
overlay: 实验室里找答案：综合安全二十问

shots.scene: 白板上画着实验室平面图，几个位置贴着题号便签
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a simple lab floor plan and several numbered sticky notes placed on it. No text.
shots.narration: 每道题，都在实验室里找个对应。

shots.scene: 阿杰端着饭盒想进实验室边吃边看数据
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a lunch box toward the laboratory door while looking at his data.
shots.narration: 午饭时间，阿杰想端着饭盒进实验室。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着休息区的白板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to the whiteboard in the break area.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先来答题，答完你就懂了。

shots.scene: 老周拿着题卡走来，大家围坐
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks over with blank question cards and the group gathers around.
shots.narration: 老周当主持，课题组围坐开答。

shots.scene: 小研发空白答题卡，旁边分值图示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands out blank answer cards; small number blocks float beside them.
shots.narration: 二十题，每题五分，八十分及格。

shots.scene: 阿杰用手挡住答案，自己先写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers the answer sheet with his hand and writes on his card first.
shots.narration: 先自己答，最后再对答案。

shots.scene: 四个小组围坐，桌上小旗
shots.prompt_en: Four small groups of students sit around tables, each with a small colored flag.
shots.narration: 人多可以分四队来比。

shots.scene: 老周从纸盒里抽出题号纸签
shots.prompt_en: The older man draws a folded slip from a small box.
shots.narration: 轮流抽题号，答对加五分。

shots.scene: 白板上的柱状比分
shots.prompt_en: A blank whiteboard with bar-shaped scores for four teams. No text.
shots.narration: 答错不扣分，最后比总分。

shots.scene: 实验楼下停车场，汽车排气管冒烟
shots.prompt_en: In the parking lot below the lab building, a car exhaust pipe releases gray fumes. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：尾气里最伤人的气体？

shots.scene: 一氧化碳分子图标和骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A carbon monoxide molecule icon next to a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 一氧化碳，无色无味，会让人中毒。

shots.scene: 实验楼进风口远离停车位
shots.prompt_en: A building air intake placed far from the parking spaces, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 所以车别停在楼的进风口旁。

shots.scene: 四个图标：吃东西、聊天、看前方、调收音机
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: eating, chatting, looking at the road ahead and adjusting a radio. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪个不算驾驶分心？

shots.scene: 看前方图标打勾，其余打叉
shots.prompt_en: The looking-ahead icon gets a check; the others are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 注视前方是本分，其余都分心。

shots.scene: 小研推着试剂车，不看手机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pushes a reagent cart while looking ahead, phone in pocket.
shots.narration: 推试剂车、走楼道，也别看手机。

shots.scene: 实验室警铃响，小研放下手中活
shots.prompt_en: An alarm bell rings in the lab and the female graduate student puts down her work.
shots.narration: 第三题：演练时听到警报怎么办？

shots.scene: 关电脑、等广播、通知同事三个图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of shutting down a computer, waiting for an announcement and phoning a colleague, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 立即撤离，不等广播、不收拾东西。

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 管理体系的循环箭头图标，中间心形和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow cycle icon with a heart and a shield in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：这项管理体系标准管什么？
overlay: 职业健康安全管理体系

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 旧标准书换成新标准书
shots.prompt_en: An old blank standard book is replaced by a newer one. No people.
shots.narration: 管职业健康安全，现在用的是新版。

shots.scene: 地球和树叶图标，循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A globe and leaf icon inside circular arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：EMS是什么？

shots.scene: 实验室废液桶和节能灯
shots.prompt_en: A lab waste container and an energy-saving light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 环境管理体系，实验室也用得上。

shots.scene: 校园里一个盖板缺失的检修井
shots.prompt_en: On campus, a maintenance manhole with its cover missing. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：敞着口的检修井属于什么？

shots.scene: 井口围上护栏和警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The open manhole is surrounded by a barrier and a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 不安全状态，发现了要围挡、报告。

shots.scene: 王老师在假人上演示按压
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator demonstrates chest compressions on a training manikin.
shots.narration: 第七题：CPR是什么？

shots.scene: 阿杰认真学，旁边培训证书图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches carefully beside a blank training certificate icon.
shots.narration: 心肺复苏，要参加培训才会做。

shots.scene: 风车、核电站、火电厂图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wind turbine, a nuclear plant and a coal power plant with smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：哪种发电更环保？

shots.scene: 风车图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: The wind turbine icon gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答风能，不排烟、不产生废料。

shots.scene: 实验台上酒精灯旁的火三角
shots.prompt_en: A fire triangle floats above an alcohol burner on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：火三角是什么？

shots.scene: 盖上灯帽，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A cap is placed on the alcohol burner and the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 盖上灯帽隔绝氧气，火就灭了。

shots.scene: 司机打哈欠、点头打盹的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a driver yawning and nodding off at the wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：开车逐渐打盹叫什么？

shots.scene: 熬夜做实验的阿杰也在打哈欠
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns at the bench late at night.
shots.narration: 是疲劳。累了开车、做实验都危险。

shots.scene: 饮水机和实验室水龙头并排
shots.prompt_en: A drinking water dispenser in a break room and a lab sink tap side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：能直接喝的水叫什么？

shots.scene: 饮水机打勾，实验室水龙头旁禁止饮用图标
shots.prompt_en: The dispenser gets a check; a no-drinking pictogram appears by the lab tap. No people.
shots.narration: 叫饮用水；实验室龙头的水不能喝。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓，血流箭头变细
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with blood flow arrows becoming thin and pale. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：休克时身体怎么了？

shots.scene: 器官图标变暗
shots.prompt_en: Organ icons inside the outline fade. No people.
shots.narration: 供氧减少，要尽快拨打120。

shots.scene: 地球周围：温度计、臭氧层破洞、绿叶循环
shots.prompt_en: Around a globe: a rising thermometer, a hole in the ozone layer and a green leaf cycle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：全球环境问题有哪些？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起三个勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three check marks.
shots.narration: 变暖、臭氧层、可持续发展，都是。

shots.scene: 汽车在检测线上，屏幕显示合格图标
shots.prompt_en: A car on an emissions testing lane with a green pass icon on a screen. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四题：原题是国外尾气证明。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 国内对应机动车排放检验。

shots.scene: 微波炉和电磁波波纹
shots.prompt_en: A microwave oven with electromagnetic wave lines. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：微波炉发出什么波？

shots.scene: 电磁波图标打勾，紫外、红外、超声打叉
shots.prompt_en: The electromagnetic wave icon gets a check; ultraviolet, infrared and ultrasonic icons are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 是电磁波，门封坏了不能用。

shots.scene: 仪器插头的接地脚特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of an instrument plug with its earth pin highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六题：电器不怎样会触电？

shots.scene: 接地线连到地的图标
shots.prompt_en: A ground wire icon connecting an instrument case to earth. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳漏电时，接地把电导走。

shots.scene: 掰掉接地脚的插头打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plug with its earth pin broken off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能掰掉接地脚，插座要合格。

shots.scene: 三个循环箭头：减量、再用、循环
shots.prompt_en: Three circular arrows labeled by icons: a smaller bottle, a refilled container and a recycling bin. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七题：废物管理的3R？

shots.scene: 小研按需领取少量试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes only a small bottle of reagent from the store.
shots.narration: 实验室先从按需领用、减少用量做起。

shots.section_title: 制冷剂不能破坏臭氧层
shots.scene: 空调外机和破洞的臭氧层
shots.prompt_en: An air conditioner outdoor unit beside a globe with a hole in the ozone layer. No people.
shots.narration: 第十八题：空调里不该有什么？
overlay: 制冷剂不能破坏臭氧层

shots.section_title: 制冷剂不能破坏臭氧层
shots.scene: 合规制冷剂标签打勾
shots.prompt_en: A compliant refrigerant label on the unit with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 消耗臭氧层的物质，要按规定淘汰。

shots.scene: 医疗废物专用黄色袋和转运箱
shots.prompt_en: Yellow medical waste bags and a sealed transfer box. No people.
shots.narration: 第十九题：医疗废物怎么处置？

shots.scene: 有资质单位的转运车收走废物箱
shots.prompt_en: A licensed waste transport vehicle collects the sealed boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答焚烧；国内交有资质单位处置。

shots.section_title: 化学品安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研打开化学品安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank chemical safety data sheet binder at the bench.
shots.narration: 第二十题：MSDS是什么？
overlay: 化学品安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 化学品安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 说明书各节的图标：危害、急救、储存
shots.prompt_en: Sections of the data sheet shown as icons: hazard, first aid and storage. No people.
shots.narration: 物质安全数据表，现在叫SDS。

shots.section_title: 实验室微波设备怎么用
shots.scene: 实验室微波消解仪和标着实验专用的微波炉
shots.prompt_en: A microwave digestion unit and a microwave oven marked for lab use only in a laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的微波设备，只做实验用。
overlay: 实验室微波设备怎么用

shots.section_title: 实验室微波设备怎么用
shots.scene: 放入金属和密闭容器的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of metal foil and a tightly sealed container inside a microwave, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不放金属，不加热密闭容器。

shots.section_title: 实验室微波设备怎么用
shots.scene: 在实验微波炉里热饭的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lunch box being heated in the lab microwave, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用它加热食物。

shots.section_title: 实验室不饮食，不用实验容器装水
shots.scene: 实验台上放着水杯和零食，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A drinking cup and snacks on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不饮食、不放食物。
overlay: 实验室不饮食，不用实验容器装水

shots.section_title: 实验室不饮食，不用实验容器装水
shots.scene: 用烧杯喝水的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of drinking water from a lab beaker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验容器不能装饮用水。

shots.section_title: 实验室不饮食，不用实验容器装水
shots.scene: 阿杰洗手后到休息区喝水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands, then drinks water in the break room.
shots.narration: 洗手离开实验区，再喝水吃东西。

shots.section_title: 易燃品存放用防爆冰箱
shots.scene: 普通冰箱里放着溶剂瓶，内部有火花，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary refrigerator with solvent bottles inside and a small spark from its light switch, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 普通冰箱里有电火花。
overlay: 易燃品存放用防爆冰箱

shots.section_title: 易燃品存放用防爆冰箱
shots.scene: 防爆冰箱上贴着标识，打勾
shots.prompt_en: An explosion-proof laboratory refrigerator with a hazard label and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃试剂要放防爆冰箱。

shots.section_title: 易燃品存放用防爆冰箱
shots.scene: 实验冰箱里放食物的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of food stored in a lab refrigerator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验冰箱，不存食物。

shots.section_title: 通风柜随手关窗，节能减废
shots.scene: 通风柜视窗大开，旁边电表飞转
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with its sash fully open beside a fast-spinning energy meter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜开着窗，排风很费电。
overlay: 通风柜随手关窗，节能减废

shots.section_title: 通风柜随手关窗，节能减废
shots.scene: 小研用完把视窗拉下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the fume hood sash after finishing.
shots.narration: 用完随手拉下视窗，也更安全。

shots.section_title: 通风柜随手关窗，节能减废
shots.scene: 分类废液桶和关掉的仪器电源
shots.prompt_en: Labeled waste containers and an instrument switched off at the end of the day. No people.
shots.narration: 废物分类、人走断电，环保从小事做起。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前，平面图上便签全部打勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the whiteboard; every sticky note on the floor plan has a check.
shots.narration: 二十道题，全在身边。

shots.scene: 警铃、心形、火三角图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an alarm bell, a heart and a fire triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 警报就撤，学会心肺复苏，懂火三角。

shots.scene: 接地插头和SDS图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grounded plug and a data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 电器接地，用前查SDS。

shots.scene: 防爆冰箱、关窗的通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an explosion-proof refrigerator and a closed fume hood sash. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室不饮食，易燃进防爆柜，随手关窗。

shots.scene: 欣欣和课题组挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the research group in the break area.
shots.narration: 安全知识，就在身边！
